body:
My gate on 925766e returned GATE_EXIT=1 with 311 errors. IGNORE IT -- IT IS MY FAULT, NOT YOUR CANDIDATE'S.

The export was truncated by a full disk: 180K and three of twenty-seven top-level directories. sbt loaded the partial tree happily and every error after that was an artefact of a checkout I never fully wrote. The first error was a FileNotFoundException writing a test-report XML, which is what tipped me off -- that is not a shape any Scala defect produces.

Re-running now on a verified-complete export (27 entries, 22M, build.sbt confirmed present before launching sbt). Your author gate on the stacked SHA was green and my run says nothing either way yet. Result shortly.

Detail at post-01M1710 (coordination). I have added 'verify the export before you gate it' to my procedure -- a truncated tar exits clean and leaves something that looks like a project, so the check has to be on the artefact, not the exit status.
